subject: Mathematics
examFormat: The aim of the UTME Mathematics syllabus is to prepare candidates for the Board's examination. The course objectives are to acquire computational and manipulative skills; develop precise, logical and formal reasoning skills; develop deductive skills in interpretation of graphs, diagrams and data; and apply mathematical concepts to resolve issues in daily living. The syllabus has five sections: Number and Numeration, Algebra, Geometry/Trigonometry, Calculus and Statistics.
recommendedTexts: Distinction in Mathematics: Comprehensive Revision Text, 3rd Edition — Adelodun, A. A. (Ado-Ekiti: FNPL, 2000)
Basic Mathematics for Senior Secondary Schools and Remedial Students in Higher Institutions — Anyebe, J. A. B. (Lagos: Kenny Moore, 1998)
New General Mathematics for West Africa SSS 1 to 3 — Channon, J. B. and Smith, A. M. (Lagos: Longman, 2001)
New School Mathematics for Senior Secondary Schools — David-Osuagwu, M. et al. (Onitsha: Africana-FIRST Publishers, 2000)
Further Mathematics — Egbe, E. et al. (Onitsha: Africana-FIRST Publishers, 2000)
Algebra and Calculus for Schools and Colleges — Ibude, S. O. et al. (LINCEL Publishers, 2003)
Further Mathematics Project Books 1 to 3 — Tuttuh-Adegun, M. R. et al. (Ibadan: NPS Educational, 1997)

topics.name: Number bases
objectives: perform four basic operations (x, +, -, ÷) in number bases
convert one base to another
perform operations in modulo arithmetic
topics.content: Operations in different number bases from 2 to 10; conversion from one base to another including fractional parts.

topics.name: Fractions, decimals, approximations and percentages
objectives: perform basic operations (x, +, -, ÷) on fractions and decimals
express to a specified number of significant figures and decimal places
calculate simple interest, profit and loss per cent, ratio, proportion, rate and percentage error
solve problems involving share and VAT
topics.content: Fractions and decimals; significant figures; decimal places; percentage errors; simple interest; profit and loss percent; ratio, proportion and rate; shares and value added tax (VAT).

topics.name: Indices, logarithms and surds
objectives: apply the laws of indices in calculation
establish the relationship between indices and logarithms in solving problems
solve equations involving indices
solve problems in different bases in logarithms
simplify and rationalize surds
perform basic operations on surds
topics.content: Laws of indices; equations involving indices; standard form; laws of logarithm; logarithm of any positive number to a given base; change of bases in logarithm and application; relationship between indices and logarithm; surds.

topics.name: Sets
objectives: identify types of sets, i.e. empty, universal, complements, subsets, finite, infinite and disjoint sets
solve problems involving cardinality of sets
solve set problems using symbols
use Venn diagrams to solve problems involving not more than 3 sets
topics.content: Types of sets; algebra of sets; Venn diagrams and their applications.

topics.name: Polynomials
objectives: find the subject of the formula of a given equation
apply factor and remainder theorem to factorize a given expression
multiply, divide polynomials of degree not more than 3 and determine values of defined and undefined expression
factorize by regrouping, difference of two squares, perfect squares and cubic expressions
solve simultaneous equations - one linear, one quadratic
interpret graphs of polynomials including applications to maximum and minimum values
topics.content: Change of subject of formula; multiplication and division of polynomials; factorization of polynomials of degree not exceeding 3; roots of polynomials not exceeding degree 3; factor and remainder theorems; simultaneous equations including one linear one quadratic; graphs of polynomials of degree not greater than 3.

topics.name: Variation
objectives: solve problems involving direct, inverse, joint and partial variations
solve problems on percentage increase and decrease in variation
topics.content: Direct; inverse; joint; partial; percentage increase and decrease.

topics.name: Inequalities
objectives: solve problems on linear and quadratic inequalities
interpret graphs of inequalities
topics.content: Analytical and graphical solutions of linear inequalities; quadratic inequalities with integral roots only.

topics.name: Progression
objectives: determine the nth term of a progression
compute the sum of A.P. and G.P.
find the sum to infinity of a given G.P.
topics.content: nth term of a progression; sum of A.P. and G.P.

topics.name: Binary operations
objectives: solve problems involving closure, commutativity, associativity and distributivity
solve problems involving identity and inverse elements
topics.content: Properties of closure, commutativity, associativity and distributivity; identity and inverse elements (simple cases only).

topics.name: Matrices and determinants
objectives: perform basic operations (x, +, -, ÷) on matrices
calculate determinants
compute inverses of 2 x 2 matrices
topics.content: Algebra of matrices not exceeding 3 x 3; determinants of matrices not exceeding 3 x 3; inverses of 2 x 2 matrices; excluding quadratic and higher degree equations.

topics.name: Euclidean geometry
objectives: identify various types of lines and angles
solve problems involving polygons
calculate angles using circle theorems
identify construction procedures of special angles, e.g. 30, 45, 60, 75, 90 degrees
topics.content: Properties of angles and lines; polygons: triangles, quadrilaterals and general polygons; circles: angle properties, cyclic quadrilaterals and intersecting chords; construction.

topics.name: Mensuration
objectives: calculate the perimeters and areas of triangles, quadrilaterals, circles and composite figures
find the length of an arc, a chord, perimeters and areas of sectors and segments of circles
calculate total surface areas and volumes of cuboids, cylinders, cones, pyramids, prisms, spheres and composite figures
determine the distance between two points on the earth's surface
topics.content: Lengths and areas of plane geometrical figures; lengths of arcs and chords of a circle; perimeters and areas of sectors and segments of circles; surface areas and volumes of simple solids and composite figures; the earth as a sphere: longitudes and latitudes.

topics.name: Loci
objectives: identify and interpret loci relating to parallel lines, perpendicular bisectors, angle bisectors and circles
topics.content: Locus in 2 dimensions based on geometric principles relating to lines and curves.

topics.name: Coordinate geometry
objectives: determine the midpoint and gradient of a line segment
find the distance between two points
identify conditions for parallelism and perpendicularity
find the equation of a line in the two-point form, point-slope form, slope-intercept form and the general form
topics.content: Midpoint and gradient of a line segment; distance between two points; parallel and perpendicular lines; equations of straight lines.

topics.name: Trigonometry
objectives: calculate the sine, cosine and tangent of angles between -360 and 360 degrees
apply special angles, e.g. 30, 45, 60, 75, 90, 105, 135 degrees, to solve simple problems in trigonometry
solve problems involving angles of elevation and depression
solve problems involving bearings
apply trigonometric formulae to find areas of triangles
solve problems involving sine and cosine graphs
topics.content: Trigonometrical ratios of angles; angles of elevation and depression; bearings; areas and solutions of triangle; graphs of sine and cosine; sine and cosine formulae.

topics.name: Differentiation
objectives: find the limit of a function
differentiate explicit algebraic and simple trigonometrical functions
topics.content: Limit of a function; differentiation of explicit algebraic and simple trigonometrical functions - sine, cosine and tangent.

topics.name: Application of differentiation
objectives: solve problems involving applications of rate of change, maxima and minima
topics.content: Rate of change; maxima and minima.

topics.name: Integration
objectives: solve problems of integration involving algebraic and simple trigonometric functions
calculate area under the curve (simple cases only)
topics.content: Integration of explicit algebraic and simple trigonometrical functions; area under the curve.

topics.name: Representation of data
objectives: identify and interpret frequency distribution tables
interpret information on histogram, bar chart and pie chart
topics.content: Frequency distribution; histogram, bar chart and pie chart.

topics.name: Measures of location
objectives: calculate the mean, mode and median of ungrouped and grouped data (simple cases only)
use ogive to find the median, quartiles and percentiles
topics.content: Mean, mode and median of ungrouped and grouped data (simple cases only); cumulative frequency.

topics.name: Measures of dispersion
objectives: calculate the range, mean deviation, variance and standard deviation of ungrouped and grouped data
topics.content: Range, mean deviation, variance and standard deviation.

topics.name: Permutation and combination
objectives: solve simple problems involving permutation and combination
topics.content: Linear and circular arrangements; arrangements involving repeated objects.

topics.name: Probability
objectives: solve simple problems in probability (including addition and multiplication)
topics.content: Experimental probability (tossing of coin, throwing of a dice etc.); addition and multiplication of probabilities (mutual and independent cases).
